description: BPSC TRE 1.0 Computer Science question paper containing Part-I General Studies and Part-II Computer Science.

questions.questionText: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 5?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Three-digit numbers range from 100 to 999. The sequence divisible by 5 is 100, 105, ..., 995. Number of terms = ((995 - 100) / 5) + 1 = 180.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rewriting the terms: (3/2) * (4/3) * (5/4) * ... * (121/120). Successive numerators and denominators cancel out, leaving 121 / 2 = 60.5.

questions.questionText: The distance between Delhi and Agra is 200 km. Suppose you are travelling from Delhi to Agra by a car. If you can maintain an average speed of 90 km/hr for 120 km and 40 km/hr for the remaining distance, how much time will you take, on average, to reach Agra?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Time for first 120 km = 120/90 = 4/3 hr = 1 hr 20 min. Remaining distance = 80 km; time = 80/40 = 2 hr. Total time = 3 hr 20 min.

questions.questionText: 10% loss on selling price is what percent loss on cost price?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: A pizza boy delivered two-fifths of his pizzas on day 1, three-fourths of his pizzas on day 2 and 9/16 of his pizzas on day 3. On which day did he deliver the most pizzas if he had the same number of pizzas in the beginning of each day?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Comparing fractions: Day 1 = 2/5 = 0.40, Day 2 = 3/4 = 0.75, Day 3 = 9/16 = 0.5625. Day 2 has the highest fraction.

questions.questionText: The cost of carpeting a room 18 m long with a carpet 75 cm wide at 4.50 per metre is 810. The breadth of the room is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Length of carpet = 810 / 4.50 = 180 m. Area of carpet = 180 * 0.75 = 135 sq m. Area of room = Length * Breadth = 18 * Breadth = 135 => Breadth = 7.5 m.

questions.questionText: Two persons A and B complete a task in 15 days, when they work together. Person A completes the task in 20 days if he works alone. How many days will B take to finish the task alone?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 1/B = 1/15 - 1/20 = (4 - 3)/60 = 1/60. Hence, B alone takes 60 days.

questions.questionText: The sum of the numerator and denominator of a fraction is 11. If 1 is added to the numerator and 2 is subtracted from the denominator, it becomes 2/3. The fraction is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let fraction be x/(11-x). Then (x+1)/(9-x) = 2/3 => 3x + 3 = 18 - 2x => 5x = 15 => x = 3. The fraction is 3/8, but according to the official key, option (E) is marked.

questions.questionText: An isotropic source of 2 candela produces light flux equal to
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Total luminous flux = 4 * pi * I = 4 * pi * 2 = 8pi lumens.

questions.questionText: The spray bottles used as window or household cleaner or perfume sprayer work on
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Atomizers and sprayers operate on Bernoulli's principle where high fluid velocity creates a low-pressure zone that draws liquid upward.

questions.questionText: The trade name of basic lead carbonate is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Basic lead carbonate (2PbCO3·Pb(OH)2) is commercially known as white lead.

questions.questionText: Which of the following elements has the largest atomic radius?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Atomic radius decreases across a period from left to right. Lithium is the leftmost element in Period 2 and has the largest radius among the choices.

questions.questionText: The phenomenon of photoperiodism in plants was discovered by
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: W. W. Garner and H. A. Allard discovered photoperiodism in 1920 while studying Maryland Mammoth tobacco.

questions.questionText: Silent Valley of Kerala is preserved because
questions.optionA: it contains very rare species of plants and animals
questions.optionB: the soil is rich in minerals
questions.optionC: the areas of land were used extensively for agriculture purposes
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Silent Valley National Park is protected because it harbors rich, undisturbed tropical rainforests and rare biodiversity like the lion-tailed macaque.

questions.questionText: During normal respiration in a mammal, the diaphragm is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In its relaxed resting state (expiration), the mammalian diaphragm curves upward into a dome or arched shape.

questions.questionText: The most important cell type associated with the immunity of the body is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Lymphocytes (B cells and T cells) are the primary white blood cells responsible for adaptive immune responses.

questions.questionText: The book entitled, Gyan Deepak was authored by a great saint
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sant Dariya Saheb of Bihar authored the spiritual philosophical treatise 'Gyan Deepak'.

questions.questionText: Which agency in India has launched UTSAH portal?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The University Grants Commission (UGC) launched the UTSAH (Undertaking Transformative Strategies and Actions in Higher Education) portal.

questions.questionText: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam Satellite Launch Vehicle Mission was launched on
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Satellite Launch Vehicle Mission was launched on 19th February 2023 from Pattipolam village, Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu.

questions.questionText: In which city was the first pure green hydrogen plant commissioned?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: India's first 99.999% pure green hydrogen pilot plant was commissioned by Oil India Limited at Jorhat, Assam (not among options A, B, or C).

questions.questionText: Which year has been declared by the UNO as the 'International Year of Millets'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The United Nations General Assembly declared 2023 as the International Year of Millets following a proposal by India.

questions.questionText: Who among the following won the 2022 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 2022 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to human rights advocate Ales Bialiatski from Belarus, along with Russian human rights organization Memorial and Ukrainian organization Center for Civil Liberties.

questions.questionText: Who is the Chairman of the State Commission for Backward Classes appointed by the Bihar Government on 2nd January, 2022?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Retired Patna High Court Justice Sanjay Kumar was appointed Chairman of the Bihar State Commission for Backward Classes.

questions.questionText: Which was the first movie in Bhojpuri?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'Ganga Maiya Tohe Piyari Chadhaibo', directed by Kundan Kumar, was released in 1963 as the first Bhojpuri-language feature film.

questions.questionText:
Arrange the following thermal power projects of India from east to west:KotaNamrupObraParichha
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: East to West arrangement: Namrup (Assam, ~95°E) -> Obra (Eastern UP, ~83°E) -> Parichha (Jhansi, UP, ~78°E) -> Kota (Rajasthan, ~75°E).

questions.questionText: Which type of climate is in India according to Trewartha?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Trewartha's climate classification, a substantial portion of the Indo-Gangetic plain and northern India is classified as Tropical/Subtropical monsoon climate.

questions.questionText: What is the normal date of withdrawal of south-west monsoon at Hyderabad?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD) isobar charts, the normal date of withdrawal of the southwest monsoon at Hyderabad is mid-October (15th October).

questions.questionText: Which of the following States has maximum urbanization?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: As per Census 2011, Goa is the most urbanized state in India with 62.17% of its population living in urban areas.

questions.questionText: 'Malnad' region is associated with which of the following plateaus of India?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Malnad (hill country) is the hilly western forested region of the Karnataka Plateau bordering the Western Ghats.

questions.questionText: South Peninsular Upland is a part of
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Peninsular Plateau of India is an ancient, stable shield that formed part of the southern supercontinent Gondwanaland.

questions.questionText: The percentage of population of Bihar with respect to India's total population is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: According to Census 2011, Bihar accounts for 8.60% of India's population; hence (E) None of the above was designated in the official key.

questions.questionText: Which of the following pairs is not correctly matched with respect to south of Ganga region in Bihar?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Patna is located south of the Ganga, while Vaishali lies north of the Ganga, making Patna-Vaishali incorrect with respect to the south Ganga plains.

questions.questionText: Who is called the 'Prophet of New India'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Raja Ram Mohan Roy is hailed as the 'Father of Modern India' and the 'Prophet of Indian Nationalism / New India' for initiating socio-religious reforms.

questions.questionText: Which revolt is mentioned in Anandamath of Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's novel 'Anandamath' (1882) is set against the backdrop of the Sannyasi Rebellion in Bengal.

questions.questionText: Who was the founder of 'Abhinav Bharat' in London?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vinayak Damodar (Veer) Savarkar established and guided the revolutionary organization Abhinav Bharat society both in India and London.

questions.questionText: Where was the Ghadar Party established?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Ghadar Party was founded in 1913 by Lala Har Dayal, Sohan Singh Bhakna, and others in San Francisco, United States of America.

questions.questionText: Who was appointed as the 'Commander in Chief' by Birsa Munda?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: During the Munda Ulgulan (rebellion), Birsa Munda appointed Gaya Munda as his chief military commander.

questions.questionText: Who formed the Bihar Socialist Party?
questions.optionA: Phulan Chand Tiwari and Rajendra Prasad
questions.optionB: Phulan Prasad Varma and Jayaprakash Narayan
questions.optionC: Raj Kumar Shukla and Swami Agnivesh
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bihar Socialist Party was established in 1931 by Phulan Prasad Varma, Jayaprakash Narayan, and Ganga Sharan Singh.

questions.questionText: In which year was the 'Bihar Provincial Congress Committee' formed with its headquarters at Patna?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bihar Provincial Congress Committee was formed in 1908 under the presidency of Sir Ali Imam.

questions.questionText: Who established a branch of the Anushilan Samiti in Patna in 1913?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Revolutionary freedom fighter Sachindra Nath Sanyal established a branch of the Anushilan Samiti at Patna in 1913.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a technique that marks the beginning of computer communications?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Time-sharing systems allowed multiple remote teletype terminals to communicate concurrently with a single mainframe, marking the inception of computer communications.

questions.questionText: Which language is better for writing structured code?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pascal was specifically designed by Niklaus Wirth to teach structured programming principles using clear control structures.

questions.questionText: Which language does a browser use to display information from the World Wide Web?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Web browsers use HTML (HyperText Markup Language) to render web pages. Since HTML is not listed, 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: Select the true statement for compiler.
questions.optionA: The input of the compiler is source program.
questions.optionB: It translates the source code into object code as a whole.
questions.optionC: The output of the compiler is object code.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A compiler takes source code as input, translates the entire program as a whole, and outputs machine or object code; hence all three statements are true.

questions.questionText: _______ is used to shift processes so they are contiguous, and all free memory is in one block.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compaction (or defragmentation) relocates allocated memory blocks to gather fragmented free space into a single contiguous pool.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a valid variable name in most programming languages?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In most programming languages (C, C++, Java, Python), identifiers cannot begin with numeric digits.

questions.questionText: Secondary memory is the long-term store for programs and data while main memory holds program and data currently in use. What kind of an organization is this?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Separating physical secondary disk storage from volatile semiconductor main RAM is a physical memory organization.

questions.questionText: If a semicolon is not used at the end of the statement, what message will be displayed by C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Classic Turbo C++ / Borland C++ compilers display the error message 'Statement missing ;'.

questions.questionText: A set of libraries that provides programmatically access to some kind of graphics 2D functions is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A graphics package provides programmatic APIs and geometric functions for rendering 2D/3D shapes and displays.

questions.questionText: Which shortcut key is used to compile and run the program in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In standard Turbo C++ IDEs, Ctrl+F9 compiles, links, and runs the active program.

questions.questionText: What does the control unit generate to control other units?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The CPU Control Unit (CU) coordinates operation by issuing timed control signals across system buses.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is user-defined header file extension used in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both standard and user-defined C/C++ header files traditionally carry the '.h' file extension.

questions.questionText: The most common addressing technique employed by a CPU is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (C) immediate addressing as per the official answer key.

questions.optionA: The program is not semantically correct
questions.optionB: The program is compiled and executed successfully
questions.optionC: The program gives a compile-time error
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In C++, deleting a null pointer (delete ptr) is completely safe, well-defined by the standard, and results in a no-op.

questions.questionText: In various devices, _______ are used to overcome the difference in data transfer speed.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Buffer registers temporarily stage data between high-speed CPUs and slower peripherals to bridge transfer speed mismatches.

questions.questionText: What do we use to extend the connectivity of the processor bus?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI) bus bridges the high-speed local processor bus to external expansion slots.

questions.questionText: In memory mapped I/O
questions.optionA: the I/O devices and the memory share the same address space
questions.optionB: the I/O devices have a separate address space
questions.optionC: the memory and I/O devices have an associated address space
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In memory-mapped I/O, I/O device registers are assigned addresses within the regular memory address space and accessed using standard memory instructions.

questions.questionText: What is the addressing called that is used in an instruction of the form ADD X Y?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Direct or absolute addressing specifies the exact memory address of the operand directly in the instruction.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly declares an array in C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The syntax for declaring a fixed-size 1D array in C++ is 'type identifier[size];', e.g., int array[10];.

questions.questionText: SQL views are also known as
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A view in SQL is a virtual table derived dynamically from the result-set of an underlying stored query.

questions.questionText: How many primary keys can be there in a table?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A relational table can define at most one primary key, which may consist of single or composite columns.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In C++, raw C-style character arrays (char[]) cannot be concatenated using the '+' operator, resulting in a compile-time error.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not constraint in SQL?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: UNION is a set operator that combines query result sets; PRIMARY KEY and NOT NULL are table constraints.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a valid aggregate function?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Standard SQL aggregate functions include COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX; COMPUTE is not a standard aggregate function.

questions.questionText: Who is the father of computer?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Charles Babbage conceptualized the Analytical Engine and is regarded as the father of the computer.

questions.questionText: If we have not specified ASC or DESC after an SQL ORDER BY clause, which of the following is used by default?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The default sorting order in an SQL ORDER BY clause is ascending (ASC).

questions.questionText: In IA-32 architecture along with the general flags, which of the following conditional flags is provided?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In x86/IA-32, conditional status flags are CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, and OF. TF, IF, and IOPL are system/control flags, making 'None of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about the HAVING clause?
questions.optionA: Similar to the WHERE clause but is used for columns rather than groups
questions.optionB: Similar to WHERE clause but is used for rows rather than columns
questions.optionC: Similar to WHERE clause but is used for groups rather than rows
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: HAVING filters aggregated groups formed by GROUP BY, unlike WHERE which filters individual table rows.

questions.questionText: The method of accessing the I/O devices by repeatedly checking the status flags is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Repeatedly polling device status register flags in a software loop is known as programmed I/O or polling.

questions.questionText: _______ clause creates temporary relation for the query on which it is defined.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The WITH clause (Common Table Expression / CTE) defines temporary named result relations scoped to an SQL query.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ROUND(65.726, -1) rounds to the nearest tens place (left of the decimal point), producing 70.

questions.questionText: The matrix contains m rows and n columns. The matrix is called Sparse Matrix if
questions.optionB: total number of zero elements = m+n
questions.optionC: total number of zero elements = m/n
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A matrix is sparse when more than half of its total elements (mn/2) are zero.

questions.questionText: _______ command makes the updates performed by the transaction permanent in the database.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The COMMIT statement saves all transactional modifications permanently to the database.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the basic approach for joining tables?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: NATURAL JOIN matches rows based on common column names across two relational tables.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of an infix to postfix conversion algorithm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Converting an infix expression of length N using an operator stack processes each token in constant time, running in O(N).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the advantage of the array data structure?
questions.optionA: Elements of mixed data types can be stored
questions.optionB: Easier to access the elements in an array
questions.optionC: Index of the first element starts from 1
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Arrays provide O(1) random access via index arithmetic, making element retrieval straightforward.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is mainly used for implementing the recursive algorithm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Function call activation records are tracked using a LIFO call stack during recursion.

questions.questionText:
What is the postfix expression for the corresponding infix expression?
a + b * c + (d * e)
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Order of operations: b*c -> bc*; a + bc* -> abc*+; (d*e) -> de*; total = abc*+de*+.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the type of queue?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Linear queues, circular queues, and double-ended queues (deques) are all recognized queue types, so 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: The necessary condition to be checked before deletion from the queue is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Attempting to delete or dequeue an element from an empty queue causes an underflow error.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: A linear data structure in which insertion and deletion operations can be performed from both the ends is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A deque (double-ended queue) allows insertions and deletions at both the front and rear ends.

questions.questionText: If circular queue is implemented using array having size MAX_SIZE in which array index starts with 0, front points to the first element in the queue, and rear points to the last element in the queue. Which one of the following conditions is used to specify that the circular queue is empty?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In 0-indexed circular array implementations, front = rear = -1 commonly represents an empty queue.

questions.optionA: Perform push() with push as the costlier operation
questions.optionB: Perform push() with pop as the costlier operation
questions.optionC: Perform pop() with push as the costlier operation
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Directly enqueuing x into q1 executes push in O(1) time, making the corresponding pop() operation the costlier O(n) task.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following techniques is not used in the binary tree?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Standard tree traversals include preorder, inorder, and postorder; 'randomized traversal' is not a standard traversal technique.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a feature of DBMS?
questions.optionA: Minimum duplication and redundancy of data
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Enterprise DBMS platforms support multi-user concurrent access; restricting access to a single user is not a defining feature.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is not true about the doubly linked list?
questions.optionA: We can traverse in both the directions.
questions.optionC: Implementation of doubly linked list is easier than the singly linked list.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Doubly linked lists require managing two pointers (next and prev) per node, making insertion and deletion more complex than in singly linked lists.

questions.questionText: The values appearing in given attributes of any tuple in the referencing relation must likewise occur in specified attributes of at least one tuple in the referenced relation, according to _______ integrity constraint.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Referential integrity requires that foreign key attribute values must match an existing primary key value in the referenced relation or be NULL.

questions.questionText: Which of the following options is not true about the binary search tree?
questions.optionA: The value of the left child should be less than the root node.
questions.optionB: The value of the right child should be greater than the root node.
questions.optionC: The left and right subtrees should also be a binary search tree.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Options A, B, and C all correctly state BST properties, making 'None of the above' the correct choice.

questions.questionText: The expression Y = AB + BC + AC shows the _______ operation.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Y = AB + BC + AC expresses an OR of AND terms, representing the Sum of Products (SOP) form.

questions.questionText: What are the canonical forms of Boolean expressions?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Standard canonical forms are Sum of Minterms (SOM) and Product of Maxterms (POM).

questions.questionText: Derive the Boolean expression for the logic circuit shown below:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (B) [C(A+B)D+E'] as per the official answer key.

questions.questionText: Boolean algebra can be used
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Boolean algebra is applied in switching circuit design, digital logic modeling, and circuit theory; hence more than one of the above applies.

questions.questionText: What does the control unit generate to control other units?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The control unit coordinates internal CPU components and peripherals by generating control signals.

questions.questionText: To display time in railway stations which digital circuit is used?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Seven-segment decoders (e.g., BCD-to-7-segment) drive digital clocks and scoreboards.

questions.questionText: What kind of transmission medium is most appropriate to carry data in a computer network that is exposed to electrical interference?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Optical fiber cable transmits data using light pulses through dielectric glass cores, making it immune to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

questions.questionText: Which network topology requires a central controller or hub?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In a star topology, each network node connects directly to a central hub, switch, or controller.

questions.questionText: A collection of hyperlinked documents on the Internet forms the
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The World Wide Web (WWW) is a system of interconnected hypertext documents accessed over the internet.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a step in the Header translation procedure?
questions.optionA: The IPv6 mapped address is changed to an IPv4 address by extracting the rightmost 32 bits
questions.optionB: The value of the IPv6 priority field is discarded
questions.optionC: The IPv6 flow label is considered
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: IPv4 headers lack a Flow Label field, so IPv6 flow label information is ignored or discarded during header translation.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following would breach the integrity of a system?
questions.optionA: Locking the room to prevent theft
questions.optionB: Full access rights for all users
questions.optionC: Fitting the system with an anti-theft device
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Granting unrestricted write and administrative permissions to all users violates the principle of least privilege and compromises data integrity.

questions.questionText: Which sublayer of the data link layer performs data link functions that depend upon the type of medium?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Media Access Control (MAC) sublayer manages physical transmission medium access and framing, which depends on the physical layer technology.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a network topology?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Peer-to-peer is a network architecture/model, whereas Ring and Bus describe physical and logical network topologies.

questions.questionText: How do structures and classes in C++ differ?
questions.optionA: Structures by default hide every member whereas classes do not
questions.optionB: In structures, members are public by default, whereas, in classes, they are private by default
questions.optionC: Structures cannot have private members, whereas classes can have
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The primary semantic difference in C++ is that struct members and base classes are public by default, whereas in classes they default to private.

questions.questionText: When the mail server sends mail to other mail servers it becomes
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In server-to-server email relaying, the originating/forwarding MTA initiates the TCP connection, acting as an SMTP client.

questions.questionText: The length of an IPv6 address is
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: An IPv6 address is 128 bits long. Because 128 bits is not listed in options A, B, or C, 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: What is the use of ios::trunc mode?
questions.optionA: To open a file in input mode
questions.optionB: To open a file in output mode
questions.optionC: To truncate an existing file to zero
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Opening a file with the ios::trunc flag discards existing content and resets the file size to zero.

questions.questionText: Which layer of the TCP/IP stack corresponds to the OSI model transport layer?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Host-to-Host layer (also known as Transport layer) in the DoD/TCP/IP reference model corresponds to Layer 4 of the OSI model.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is/are correct?It is not possible to combine two or more files opening mode in open() method.It is possible to combine two or more files opening mode in open() method.ios::in and ios::out are input and output file opening modes respectively.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Modes can be combined using the bitwise OR operator (e.g., ios::in | ios::out), and ios::in / ios::out are standard stream opening modes.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true with regard to the ping command?
questions.optionA: Ping stands for Packet Internet Generator.
questions.optionB: The ping command checks the port level connectivity between source destinations endpoints.
questions.optionC: Ping summarizes the packet loss and round-trip delay between two IP endpoints.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ping uses ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply messages to test IP reachability and report round-trip times and packet loss.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (C) as per the official answer key (syntactically representing int** fun(float*, char**)).

questions.questionText: The private key in asymmetric key cryptography is kept by
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In asymmetric cryptography, the private key is kept confidential by the owner/receiver to decrypt data encrypted with their corresponding public key.

questions.questionText: Which of the following features must be supported by any programming language to become a pure object-oriented programming language?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pure object-oriented programming languages require support for core principles including encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction.

questions.questionText: Which is correct syntax of inheritance?
questions.optionA: class access base_classname : derived_classname {/define class body/};
questions.optionB: class derived_classname : access base_classname {/define class body/};
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The standard syntax for derived classes in C++ is 'class DerivedName : access-specifier BaseName { ... };'.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the correct definition of "is_array();" function in C++?
questions.optionA: It checks that the specified variable is of the array or not
questions.optionB: It checks that the specified array is of single dimension or not
questions.optionC: It checks that the specified array is of multi-dimension or not
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In standard type traits (std::is_array), it determines whether a given type is an array type.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is correct about the class?
questions.optionA: An object is an instance of its class.
questions.optionB: A class is an instance of its object.
questions.optionC: An object is the instance of the data type of that class.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A class acts as a blueprint or user-defined type, and an object is a concrete instance of that class.

questions.questionText: Which of the following can be used to create an abstract class in the C++ programming language?
questions.optionA: By using the pure virtual function in the class
questions.optionB: By declaring a virtual function in the base class
questions.optionC: By declaring the virtual keyword afterward the class declaration
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Declaring at least one pure virtual function (e.g., virtual void func() = 0;) in a class makes it an abstract class in C++.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is correct about the C++ programming language?
questions.optionA: In C++, both the static and dynamic types checking are allowed.
questions.optionB: In C++, member function are allowed to be of the type const.
questions.optionC: In C++, dynamic checking is allowed.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C++ supports static and dynamic type checking (via RTTI/dynamic_cast) as well as const member functions, making more than one statement correct.
